text: Near East University (Yakın Doğu Üniversitesi) is a private university located in North Nicosia, Northern Cyprus, founded in 1988 by Suat Günsel.
Near East University is the largest university in Northern Cyprus, with more than 26,000 students and around 1,200 academic staff, including students from over 100 nationalities.
The university has 20 faculties comprising around 220 departments, four vocational training centres, eight graduate schools, 28 research institutes, and three associated high schools.
Academic subjects offered at Near East University include arts, sciences, law, medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, fine art and design, and veterinary medicine.

Near East University's Faculty of Medicine opened in 2008, with its adjacent teaching hospital, Near East University Hospital, completed in 2009. Its Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry, and Faculty of Pharmacy are the only ones of their kind in North Cyprus.
